{{Top|leg}}
'''Lunavolver Delta''' was a cylindrical [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. It was a major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] containing 360 [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. It rotated along the axis of its cylinder for gravity and even sunlight distribution. The [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] [[Republic Sienar Systems Diplomatic Headquarters|Diplomatic Headquarters]] was located on Lunavolver Delta. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] maintained an office there as well, for he headed the diplomatic agency.

[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters Guild]] met on Lunavolver Delta on joint assignments to kill Senator Rodd and two of his associates. The [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] and ''[[Merciless Captivator]]'' were temporarily docked in the station's hangars.
